data.description: 月夜下的江面浮光跃金，一艘描金画舫缓缓行于水上。令倚在舫头凭栏，素白羽衣的衣摆浸着水光，提着一只酒盏遥遥对月。江风送来她低低的吟诵——「醉后不知天在水，满船清梦压星河。」
data.lighting: moonlit river reflections, golden lantern bokeh from the cabin, silver water ripples
data.promptProse: Leaning one forearm on the boat railing, she raises the wine cup in her other hand toward the moon, cabin lanterns warming the folds beside the silver river.
data.title: 令 · 江上画舫夜航
data.animaCaption: One forearm rests on the rail as she lifts the wine cup toward the moon.
